title: Rapid, reliable, and cheap point-of-care bulk testing for SARS-CoV-2 by combining hybridization capture with improved colorimetric LAMP (Cap-iLAMP)
protocol: Mix an aliquot of 2 ml Lysis Binding Buffer (LysBB, 2x concentrated) with 2 ml water to obtain 1x concentrated LysBB for bead washing.
Transfer 20 µl Dynabeads™ MyOne™ Streptavidin C1 per reaction to 1.5 ml tubes.
Place the tube in a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 500 µl 1x LysBB, place in a magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the resuspension step once more with 500 µl 1x LysBB.
Resuspend washed beads in 100 µl 1x LysBB per reaction.
Add 2 µl of CV2_btn (100 µM) and 2 µl CV16_btn (100 µM) per reaction, rotate tubes for 10 minutes at room temperature for binding of the oligonucleotides to the beads.
Place tube on a magnetic rack, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 40 µl alkaline melt solution per reaction.
Incubate the suspension for 5 minutes at room temperature, then place tube in a magnetic rack and discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 40 µl 1x LysBB per reaction, place in a magnetic rack, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend washed beads in 100 µl 2x LysBB per reaction.
Distribute 100 µl of suspension to single 1.5 ml tubes if multiple reactions were prepared at once.
Add 400 µl of 2x LysBB to each tube.
Mix by pipetting to obtain a volume of 500 µl.
Add 500 µl of sample or water (negative control) or 499.5 µl of water and 0.5 µl synthetic SARS-CoV-2 RNA control 2 (positive control) to 500 µl bead suspension.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 55°C for 10 min.
Place the suspension on a magnetic rack, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 200 µl wash buffer, place the suspension on a magnetic rack, discard the supernatant.
Repeat this wash step once.
Resuspend the beads in 200 µl low salt buffer, place the suspension on a magnetic rack, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 25 µl elution buffer, incubate at 60°C for 2 min.
Place the reaction on a magnetic rack, transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube, discard the beads.
To 20 µl of LAMP master mix, add 10 µl of eluate from the captures, mix by pipetting.
Add 0.5 µl of SYBR green I to the cap of the tube without getting in contact with the reaction volume.
Incubate the reactions for 40 min at 65°C.
Shake the tube to mix the reaction volume with the SYBR green I in the cap.
